hotels.title: Stylish Central Copenhagen Escape Near Tivoli Gardens with Onsite Restaurant & Two Bars
hotels.description: Right in the heart of Copenhagen, 25hours Hotel Indre By is the perfect haven for discovering a city known for historic canals, colorful buildings and innovative and sustainable living. A 19th-century building formerly a porcelain factory and university, this hotel is now a design playground packed with colour and character. You’re steps from buzzing Strøget, the Round Tower and canal-side strolls, but with rooms this cool, you might never want to leave. The hotel is a playground for grown-ups, boasting a sauna for slow mornings and bikes to borrow when you’re ready to roll. Tuck into Middle Eastern feasts at NENI København or sip something strong at the speakeasy-style rendezvous bar. Whether you're here to work, wander or just hang, Indre By lets you discover Copenhagen on your own terms.

hotels.title: Copenhagen Sustainable Retreat near Denmark's Largest Shopping Mall
hotels.description: A pioneer in Danish sustainability without sacrificing style or comfort, Crowne Plaza Copenhagen Towers, an IHG Hotel, is minutes from the city centre and the airport. Savour locally-sourced Nordic cuisine in true American diner fashion at BARK restaurant. Then, splurge on some retail therapy at Field's, Denmark's largest shopping mall, less than a five-minute walk from the hotel, or head out to soak up the picturesque architecture and canals of this modern Scandinavian city.
